name: long-task-notifier
description: Shows a live timer for long-running Bash commands and background tasks, then toasts, chimes and sends a desktop notification when they finish, on Linux, macOS and Windows.

thresholdSeconds.title: Threshold (seconds)
thresholdSeconds.description: Only commands that run at least this many seconds get a timer and a notification

sound.title: Chime when done
sound.description: Play a short sound when a long task finishes (paplay on Linux, afplay on macOS, a Windows system sound)

desktopNotification.title: Desktop notification
desktopNotification.description: Also send a desktop notification (notify-send on Linux, Notification Center on macOS, a toast on Windows)
